anchor_alternative: Mean of latest four published completed quarters plus mean seasonal offsets from up to three prior same-calendar quarters; each offset is that quarter's margin minus its trailing-four-quarter mean
blend: 50% frozen prior-year anchor plus 50% recent-level seasonal alternative
market_adjustment: Exactly preserve archived production prediction minus its original prior-year anchor; no coefficient refit
availability: All anchor inputs must be earlier completed quarters published strictly before target quarter-end; no gaps in four-quarter windows
regimes: Report pre2020, 2020 transition and 2021 onward separately; no pooled promotion statistic
primary_tail_metrics: frequency absolute error >= 5 cents per gallon
ordinary_group: Original production absolute error below fixed 5-cent threshold; membership never selected from challenger errors
exceptional_anchor: Prior-year anchor differs by >=5 cents from mean of up to two earlier same-calendar quarters; require both earlier seasons
persistence: Descriptive scoring only: actual stays >=5 cents from that older seasonal mean in the same direction as prior-year anomaly; never a predictor or activation rule
activation: All eligible quarters; no named-year exception or ex-post risk trigger
promotion: Existing gate and separately reported tail metrics; no automatic promotion
tuning: One formula and blend, no weights grid; already examined history remains developmental
